summary: Rocket Lab filed an 8-K updating financing for its previously announced acquisition of Iridium Communications under a June 28, 2026 merger agreement. The transaction uses a two-step structure: Merger Sub I merges into Iridium, which survives as an indirect Rocket Lab subsidiary, then merges into Merger Sub II. The September 15, 2026 disclosure covers an amendment to Iridium's September 20, 2023 credit agreement involving Iridium Holdings, Iridium Satellite, Deutsche Bank as administrative and collateral agent, and required lenders, alongside a Regulation FD press release. Watch financing conditions, lender consents, regulatory approvals and closing timing.
